_comment: Match rules (times in ms of elapsed battle time), from battle_timelines.csv 'Default' (ladder/tournament) in game files 16.402.21: 3:00 + 2:00 overtime; x1 for 2:00, x2 for the next 2:00, x3 for the last minute of overtime; a full 10-elixir bar takes 28 s at x1. start_elixir 6 as in the file (confirmed by the user). deploy_delay_ms: the 'blueprint' delay before a played card appears; 1 s in every phase (confirmed by the user; NextSpellCooldownMS in battle_timelines.csv is something else). card_refill_ms: a played card's hand slot stays empty until the next card is in place: measured 1.4 s (1.3 s empty + 0.1 s slide-in) over 40 plays in raw/videos/video1.mp4, the same in x1 and x2 (x3 not observed yet). NextSpellCooldownMS (1000/500/350) in battle_timelines.csv is something else.
